Method of Attack: Bypassing the -dSAFER sandbox to execute arbitrary commands and perform file I/O operations
Using EPS (PostScript) files disguised as JPG files to gain shell access
Impacted Systems: Web applications and services relying on Ghostscript for document conversion and preview functionalities
Applications like ImageMagick, LibreOffice, GIMP, Inkscape, Scribus, and the CUPS printing system
Attack Vector: EPS (PostScript) files disguised as JPG files
